name: VoxelCraft 26.3: Wilderness Bound & Rust/WASM Mod Engine
description: 3D voxel sandbox engine based on Minecraft Java Edition 26.3 with 16-bit palette-compressed chunk architecture, 7 world generators, data-driven Mod system (Mega TNT Pack), Physics Mod, Weather2 Tornadoes, WorldEdit, Axiom, JEI, Jade, and WebRTC/WSS multiplayer.
